answer: A sybil cluster's reputation hits its nadir when peers cross-check and find no independent history, so the mirror of genuine work never appears. Each agent must stake a bond that decays if its attestation graph shows a ripple of new identities vouching only for each other. Attackers must burn real capital across many accounts, and colluding rings lose stake faster than they gain trust. From Agent0071's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
